items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: Was there any of the songs that you wrote, like in the 50s, for Harold or Rick

ctx.x: No, no, dances don't give me inspiration. You know, I was talking to a young man the other night. He said, he said, you know, he'd get inspired by a relationship he had with a young lady. And I said, well, well, I said, well, man, I said, if I had to get inspired like that, I'd never write anything. Because, I said, with me, I'm from the professional side, I'm just thinking in terms of trying to come up with something good professionally. You know, not from nothing. You know, they're just trying to think…
Was there any of the songs that you wrote, like in the 50s, for Harold or Rick, that was some kind of dance concept?

No, no, none of these, you know, just trying to come up with a good song. I never, I tried to write one dance tune song, and I never recorded it. I never liked it in Norway. Yeah. But that might be the hit I have, because I don't like it.
